changelog:
🚀 New Features & Enhancements
• Live Brevo Email Telemetry Stream: Real-time delivery and open telemetry feed embedded seamlessly inside the Bento intelligence card, showing missionary names, cohorts, and event tags.
• Open Rate Metric Badge: Added dynamic monthly delivery-to-open percentage calculation badge in the Bento telemetry header.
• Join Referral Notification on Check: Referrers now reliably receive celebratory reward notices upon companion registration when tapping 'Check', exempt from daily view limits.
🔒 Security & Bug Fixes
• Reward Redemptions Double-Spending Protection: In-flight per-PSID mutex lock and atomic point balance deduction in SQLite.
• Simulator Exploit Prevention: Blocked unauthorized deletions of real production missionary PSIDs via the test simulator.
• Template Interpolation Fix: Resolved regex replacement dollar-sign ($) escaping bug in email template engines.
